sources.snippet: Overview Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-Claude-4.7-Opus-Reasoning-Distilled-APEX-MTP-GGUF is a quantized Mixture-of-Experts language model built on the Qwen 3.6 35B-A3B architecture with knowledge distillation from Claude 4.7 Opus, optimized for reasoning tasks. Maintained by mudler, it bundles a multi-token prediction (MTP) head for self-speculative decoding in a single GGUF file compatible with llama.cpp ...
